name: Exercise 2 — The bend
summary: The corridor turns. Eight to ten aircraft, and nothing turns unless you tell it to.
briefing: The corridor comes in from the south-west and bends left by about 65° towards the north-west. Aircraft fly the heading you give them and nothing else — if you do not turn them at the bend they will leave controlled airspace. 10 aircraft, both directions, and several need a level change to reach their exit level.
